verdict.rationale: Pulumi describes itself as an open-source platform. Its documented DIY backend keeps state in object storage you manage (S3, Azure Blob, GCS), so the core IaC engine can run entirely on user-controlled infrastructure without Pulumi Cloud. Pricing also lists "Self-hosting available" for the managed service, which a community report says is limited to the Enterprise Edition. One older community comment claims Pulumi needed "the mothership" and could not run airgapped, but the DIY backend docs contradict this, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: self-hosted Pulumi Cloud gated to Enterprise, no documented airgapped deployment guide, no independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-managed setup.
